verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail lets users write custom Auto Labels as short AI prompts. These apply automatically to incoming email, so a user-defined rule fires on an arrival event, but the documented action is limited to labeling and splitting the inbox into tabs, and the feature is restricted to Business and Enterprise plans. A whats-new item mentions agents that run 'based on triggers you set', but it does not clearly say this applies to Mail, and it documents no trigger or action types. Missing for 10: documented user-defined rules with actions beyond labeling (archive, forward, reply, external calls), a clear catalog of event triggers, explicit Mail scope and detail for the trigger-based agent builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".
Custom Auto Labels let you categorize emails with your own AI prompts. (Available for our Business and Enterprise customers.)
Emails are labeled the moment they arrive, so you can see what's important and what's not.
Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.
